known_facts_book1: Rock fairies who serve the Nome King and labour at the furnaces and forges of the Underground World, making gold, silver, jewels and metals.
Squat and fat, rock-colored, they cling to the cliff face like flies and greet the visitors with weird mocking laughter.
The King's soldiers wear glittering steel armor, an electric light on each brow, and bear spears, swords and bronze battle-axes.
They fill the underground cavern in vast numbers to intimidate Ozma's small army.
Cannot bear eggs, which are rank poison to them in the underground kingdom; they flee in terror when the Scarecrow throws Billina's eggs.
Their pursuit collapses when Dorothy turns the foremost warriors into eggs with the magic belt.

known_relations_book1.Nome King: Their ruler Roquat, whom they serve and obey.
known_relations_book1.Chief Steward: A Nome of higher rank who serves the King's table.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The invading Ruler of Oz whose army they vastly outnumber.
known_relations_book1.Billina: Whose eggs are the poison that routs them.

known_facts_book1: A Nome who wears a heavy gold chain to show his rank as Chief Steward of the Nome King, and serves the King's refreshments.
Speaks bluntly to his master, calling him a fool for playing the guessing game one victim at a time.
Lets slip within Billina's hearing that the royal family are purple ornaments and the Oz people green ornaments.
Wishes aloud that he wore the magic belt so he could be a wiser King.
Later mops the broken eggs from the blinded King's face and points out the King's magic belt is gone.

known_relations_book1.Nome King: His master, whom he scolds and serves and whose secret he carelessly reveals.
known_relations_book1.Billina: The hidden hen who overhears his indiscretion and uses it to free everyone.
